sources.title: Russian-Polish first-partition acts, 1772–1773
sources.institution: Архив внешней политики Российской империи / official treaty publications
sources.coverage: Russian-Prussian partition convention, Russian annexation act and the 1773 Russia-Poland cession treaty
sources.notes: The digital documentary publication identifies AVPRI archival originals and the Martens treaty publication. History Core uses the 1772 Russian act for unilateral incorporation chronology and the 1773 bilateral treaty separately for Polish cession/recognition.

sources.title: Russian-Bukharan peace conditions and treaty publications, 1868
sources.coverage: Kaufman's 1868 peace conditions and documentary treaty record governing Samarkand and the Zarafshan acquisition
sources.notes: The published conditions explicitly place Samarkand and dependent settlements under the Russian Emperor and state that the Bukhara boundary would be fixed upon acceptance. Cross-checked against later Russian treaty collections and the RGIA Kaufman archival file already indexed in History Core.
